definition: The default cut of an archetype at its family default density.
examples: the variant every archetype ships first

definition: More items and smaller type than the standard cut; used when the deck density dial is 4 or 5.
examples: a KPI grid at dense carries 6 tiles rather than 4 (research/03 §(c) level 4)

definition: Fewer items and larger type than the standard cut; used when the deck density dial is 1 or 2.
examples: a KPI grid at sparse carries 2-3 tiles and no sparklines (research/03 §(c) levels 1-2)
